name: Explore Elmbridge Museum's local history
summary: Elmbridge Museum does not occupy one public museum building. Instead, it shares the borough's history through online exhibitions, a searchable collection and changing displays at the Civic Centre and local libraries, useful for researching Walton and Hersham before a heritage walk.
reasonToVisit: Free online exhibitions and rotating local-history displays for the whole borough
planningDetail: No single museum building — check the website for current displays at the Civic Centre and libraries
